reviews.title: Do not download - Password & login theft, phishing attack
reviews.text: I examined an app I had installed on an emulator because its login page didn’t resemble Instagram’s official interface. After stripping back the interface, I confirmed it was a phishing page designed to capture login details. When you enter your credentials, it deliberately returns an “incorrect password” error and prompts a password reset. If you choose to log in using a code instead, it then requests your phone number and redirects to Meta’s verification page. You receive a text with a code, and once you enter it, the app captures this login session within a virtual machine. This session is stored remotely, allowing the app’s creators to access your account through that saved session and change your account details using the new password.

reviews.title: WORKS BUT MESSES UP ACCOUNT AFTER TWO DAYS!
reviews.text:
I’m writing this review because my Instagram account started having issues after using this app, so I wanted to share my experience.

I downloaded the app because I wanted an easy way to see who unfollowed me on Instagram. I didn’t feel like downloading all of my Instagram data, so I decided to try this instead. I bought the one-week subscription (I think it was either $5 or $10).

At first, the app actually worked. However, about two days later, my Instagram account started acting up. I couldn’t view people’s profiles, and my account seemed to have restrictions. From what I’ve learned, apps like this use bots to scan your account and see who follows or unfollows you, and that can trigger Instagram’s security systems.

As soon as I logged into the app, I changed my Instagram password because I was worried after reading reviews about people’s accounts getting hacked. I’m glad I did. Even after changing my password, my account still had problems a couple of days later. I even deleted and reinstalled Instagram, but that didn’t fix it right away. Thankfully, my account has slowly started working normally again.

I ended up deleting the app because it just wasn’t worth the hassle. The app does work for what it promises, but there are definitely risks. If you decide to use it, I highly recommend changing your Instagram password immediately afterward.

I wanted to leave a one-star review because of what happened, but to be fair, I’ll give it two stars. It does what it’s supposed to

Upon checking it again I was greeted with a message on IG saying automated behavior had been detected and that it blocked the app from continuing the report to prevent my account being disabled or banned. I’ve been wondering why the number of accounts I followed had been randomly fluctuating despite me not making any changes myself and this explains it. 

In addition to this app taking control of your account and following/unfollowing others at random, it also failed to accurately update stats. I know for a 100% fact that I’ve both gained and lost many followers but this app never reported such things and even failed to update accounts designated as “deactivated” by Instagram. This whole thing seems to just be a data mining scam. I don’t recommend using this app at all.

reviews.title: Subject: Request for Refund – Report+ App
reviews.text:
Dear Report+ Team,

Unfortunately, the app has proven completely irrelevant to my needs. I have been unable to use core functions, such as performing mass unfollows or any significant interactions. I reached out to Instagram support, and they confirmed no problems on their side. As a result, I cannot recommend this app to anyone.

I kindly ask you to process my refund at your earliest convenience. I look forward to your prompt response.

reviews.title: Premium subscription - never worked
reviews.text:
I just purchased a one-year premium subscription for the Reports+ app 2 days ago, but unfortunately the app has not worked properly at all.

Every time I log into Reports+, I immediately receive a notification from Instagram saying that there is an unrecognized device signing into my account. When I confirm “This was me” and proceed to the Reports+ app, I am prompted to refresh the reports. The refresh loads up to about 40%, then I receive a pop-up message telling me to “please wait a few minutes to reload.”

After this, I am unable to see any data at all — including followers, unfollowers, profile views, or any reports that are supposed to be included with the premium subscription.

Additionally, after attempting to use the app, Instagram signs me out automatically for security reasons. When this happens, I am also logged out of the Reports+ app. I then have to log back into both Instagram and Reports+, only for the same issue to repeat again.

Because of this, I have had zero access to the premium features I paid for, despite having an active one-year subscription. The app continuously logs me out and provides no usable reports.

Please advise on how to fix this issue as soon as possible. If this problem cannot be resolved, I would like to request a refund for my premium subscription, as the service has not been usable.
